name: morphing-hamburger
title: Morphing Hamburger
description: The three-bar icon that becomes an X through genuine morphing: bars are separate elements whose rotations and translations interpolate through a shared keyframe timeline, so the middle bar thins and fades while the outer bars cross precisely.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Swiss
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Click Toggle: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
